title_en: 15th International Conference on Natural Language Processing (NLP 2026)
title: 15th International Conference on Natural Language Processing (NLP 2026)
description_en: The 15th International Conference on Natural Language Processing (NLP 2026) is a programmed approach to analyze text based on both theories and technologies. This forum aims to bring together researchers who have designed and built software that will analyze, understand, and generate languages that humans use naturally to address computers. Topics include chunking, dialog systems, discourse, information extraction, information retrieval, machine translation, question answering, semantic processing, speech recognition, and text mining.
description: The 15th International Conference on Natural Language Processing (NLP 2026) is a programmed approach to analyze text based on both theories and technologies.
domains: natural language processing, machine learning, information systems

title_en: Deep Learning Frontiers in Natural Language Processing (DL Frontiers in NLP) at IEEE ISSATK 2026
title: DL Frontiers in NLP 2026
description_en: Special Session on Deep Learning Frontiers in Natural Language Processing at IEEE ISSATK 2026. The session focuses on recent advances and emerging trends in deep learning methods for NLP, bringing together researchers to present innovative approaches, discuss open challenges, and explore future directions. Topics include machine translation, sentiment analysis, question answering, text classification, named entity recognition, text summarization, dialogue systems, multilingual NLP, low-resource NLP, and more.
description: Special Session on Deep Learning Frontiers in NLP at IEEE ISSATK 2026, Hammamet, Tunisia.
domains: natural language processing, deep learning, artificial intelligence

title_en: Journal Natural Language Processing - Special Issue on Language Models for Low-Resource Languages
title: NLP-LoResNLP 2026
description_en: Special issue of the Journal of Natural Language Processing focused on language models for low-resource languages. Neural language models have revolutionised NLP but struggle with low-resource languages. This special issue provides a forum for researchers to share work on developing, adapting, and evaluating language models for low-resource languages, including multilingual models, corpora creation, benchmarks, and applications like machine translation and chatbots.
description: Special Issue on Language Models for Low-Resource Languages in the Journal Natural Language Processing.
domains: natural language processing, low-resource languages, language models

title_en: Natural Language Processing, Text Mining and Applications (NLP-TEMA 2025) Track of EPIA 2025
title: NLP-TEMA 2025
description_en: NLP-TEMA 2025 is a forum for researchers working in Human Language Technologies including NLP, Computational Linguistics, Natural Language Engineering, Text Mining, and Information Retrieval. Held at the 24th Portuguese Conference on Artificial Intelligence (EPIA 2025) at Universidade do Algarve, Faro, Portugal. Topics include language modeling, tagging, parsing, morphology, text clustering, sentiment analysis, machine translation, information retrieval, question answering, and health/biomedical/legal text mining applications.
description: NLP-TEMA 2025 track at EPIA 2025, Faro, Portugal. Forum for researchers in Human Language Technologies.
domains: natural language processing, text mining, computational linguistics

title_en: The 10th Workshop on NLP for Slavic Languages (Slav-NLP 2025)
title: Slav-NLP 2025
description_en: The 10th edition of the Slav-NLP Workshop co-located with ACL 2025 in Vienna, Austria. Slavic languages play an important role with over 400M speakers worldwide. The workshop gathers researchers from academia and industry to stimulate research in Slavic NLP, foster creation of tools and resources, and discuss challenges. Topics include language modeling, morphological/syntactic/semantic analysis, named-entity recognition, text normalization, coreference resolution, information extraction, question answering, text summarization, machine translation, and sentiment analysis. Features a Shared Task on Detection and Classification of Persuasion Techniques in Slavic languages.
description: 10th Workshop on NLP for Slavic Languages, co-located with ACL 2025, Vienna, Austria.
domains: natural language processing, computational linguistics, Slavic languages

title_en: 20th International Joint Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (iSAI-NLP 2025)
title: iSAI-NLP 2025
description_en: The 20th International Joint Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing organized by AIAT, hosted by College of Computing, PSU Phuket Campus. The conference encourages knowledge-sharing and technological advancement among AI and NLP researchers worldwide. Topics include machine learning, data analytics, robotics, IoT, embedded systems, signal and image processing, speech processing, smart technology, cybersecurity, and generative AI. Hybrid format (in-person and virtual).
description: iSAI-NLP 2025: 20th International Joint Symposium on AI and NLP, Phuket, Thailand. Hybrid format.
domains: artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning

title_en: International Journal of Network Security & Its Applications (IJNSA 2026)
title: IJNSA 2026
description_en: The International Journal of Network Security & Its Applications (IJNSA) is a bi-monthly open access peer-reviewed journal publishing articles on computer network security and its applications. ERA Indexed with H-Index 52. Topics include AI/ML for security, blockchain and cybersecurity, cloud/fog/edge security, cryptographic protocols, cyber physical system security, database and system security, IoT security, intrusion detection, mobile network security, and more. Acceptance rate less than 20%.
description: IJNSA: Bi-monthly open access peer-reviewed journal on Network Security. ERA Indexed, H-Index 52.
domains: network security, artificial intelligence, machine learning

title_en: The Seventh Workshop on e-Commerce and NLP (ECNLP 7) at LREC-COLING 2024
title: EC-NLP 2024
description_en: The Seventh Workshop on e-Commerce and NLP co-located with LREC-COLING 2024 in Torino, Italy. ECNLP focuses on NLP for e-Commerce and online shopping applications. Topics include product classification, NER for products, search and auto-completion, recommender systems, machine translation for e-commerce, voice and dialogue-based applications, fraud detection, product description summarization, product similarity, sentiment analysis, and shopping assistants.
description: 7th Workshop on e-Commerce and NLP at LREC-COLING 2024, Torino, Italy.
domains: natural language processing, e-commerce, information retrieval

title_en: Natural Language Processing, Text Mining and Applications (NLP-TeMA 2023) Track of EPIA 2023
title: NLP-TeMA 2023
description_en: NLP-TeMA 2023 is the Track of Natural Language Processing, Text Mining and Applications at the 22nd Portuguese Conference on Artificial Intelligence (EPIA 2023) held at Horta, Faial island, Azores, Portugal. Forum for researchers in Human Language Technologies. Topics include NLP theories, entity recognition, distributional semantics, text clustering, sentiment analysis, machine translation, information retrieval, question answering, and biomedical/legal text mining. Published in Springer LNAI. Conference grants Best Paper Award and Best Student Paper Award.
description: NLP-TeMA 2023 track at EPIA 2023, Azores, Portugal. Published in Springer LNAI.
domains: natural language processing, text mining, computational linguistics

title_en: The 18th International Joint Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing and International Conference on AI and Internet of Things (iSAI-NLP-AIoT 2023)
title: iSAI-NLP-AIoT 2023
description_en: iSAI-NLP-AIoT 2023 provides a stage for international researchers and scholars to exchange ideas, knowledge, and techniques in artificial intelligence and natural language processing. The conference covers NLP, data analytics, machine learning, robotics, Internet of Things, embedded systems, signal and image processing, speech processing, smart industrial technology, and security.
description: 18th International Joint Symposium on AI, NLP and IoT, Bangkok, Thailand, November 2023.
domains: artificial intelligence, natural language processing, internet of things
